name: go-to-dialog
title: Go to dialog
description: Jump to a page, line, row or date from the keyboard: a one-field dialog opened by a shortcut, with the range as its hint, as-you-type checks and Enter to go.
docs: kind is number or date. A number is checked as it is typed (whole numbers, between min and max) and named in words; a date is the library's DateField in the order the locale writes it. min, max and defaultValue are numbers, or ISO dates for a date. onGo runs once the dialog has closed and given focus back, so you can move focus to where you went. shortcut defaults to mod+g (Command on a Mac, Control elsewhere), is ignored while someone types in another field or another modal is open, and false turns it off. validate.ts has checkNumber, to run the same check on the server.
